All 7 tests pass. Here's what was wrong and what changed:

**`journal.py:28` — `publish` stored the UTC date instead of the author's local date.** An author in Hawaii posting at 23:30 local (= 09:30 UTC next day) would see tomorrow's date on their post. Fix: `now.astimezone(ZoneInfo(client_tz)).date().isoformat()`.
